-- Match candidate queue/details
--
-- Purpose:
--   Prevent many-to-many row explosion by storing one review queue row per
--   original channel option, while keeping duplicate candidate details in a
--   separate child table.

create table if not exists review.match_candidate_queue (
  queue_id bigserial primary key,
  source_batch_id text,
  source_channel text not null,
  source_row_no text,
  channel_product_code text,
  channel_option_code text,
  channel_product_name text,
  channel_option_name text,
  channel_seller_code text,
  channel_stock integer,
  channel_status text,
  best_sellpia_product_code text,
  best_sellpia_sku_code text,
  best_sellpia_product_name text,
  best_sellpia_option_name text,
  match_tier text not null default 'UNCLASSIFIED',
  match_score numeric,
  match_reason text,
  duplicate_candidate_count integer not null default 0,
  duplicate_risk text,
  review_required boolean not null default false,
  recommended_action text,
  evidence_json jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

create index if not exists ix_match_candidate_queue_channel_tier
  on review.match_candidate_queue(source_channel, match_tier)

create index if not exists ix_match_candidate_queue_channel_option
  on review.match_candidate_queue(source_channel, channel_product_code, channel_option_code)

create index if not exists ix_match_candidate_queue_sellpia_sku
  on review.match_candidate_queue(best_sellpia_sku_code)

create index if not exists ix_match_candidate_queue_review_required
  on review.match_candidate_queue(source_channel, review_required)

create table if not exists review.match_candidate_details (
  detail_id bigserial primary key,
  queue_id bigint not null references review.match_candidate_queue(queue_id) on update cascade on delete cascade,
  candidate_rank integer not null,
  sellpia_product_code text,
  sellpia_sku_code text,
  sellpia_product_name text,
  sellpia_option_name text,
  match_score numeric,
  match_reason text,
  risk_flags text,
  evidence_json jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

create index if not exists ix_match_candidate_details_queue_rank
  on review.match_candidate_details(queue_id, candidate_rank)

create index if not exists ix_match_candidate_details_sellpia_sku
  on review.match_candidate_details(sellpia_sku_code)
alter table review.match_candidate_queue enable row level security
alter table review.match_candidate_details enable row level security

create policy "match candidate queue readable"
  on review.match_candidate_queue
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)

create policy "match candidate details readable"
  on review.match_candidate_details
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true)
